require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'json'
require 'ipaddr'
require 'resolv'

module ProxyConfig
  BLOCKED_RANGES = [
    IPAddr.new('127.0.0.0/8'),
    IPAddr.new('10.0.0.0/8'),
    IPAddr.new('172.16.0.0/12'),
    IPAddr.new('192.168.0.0/16'),
    IPAddr.new('169.254.0.0/16'),
    IPAddr.new('0.0.0.0/8')
  ].freeze

  ALLOWED_SCHEMES = %w[http https].freeze
  MAX_REDIRECTS = 5

  def self.upstream_resolver
    ENV.fetch('PROXY_RESOLVER', 'system')
  end

  def self.trust_mode
    ENV.fetch('PROXY_TRUST_MODE', 'strict')
  end

  def self.allowed_hosts_pattern
    ENV.fetch('PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS', '.*')
  end
end

module DNSResolver
  def self.resolve(hostname, resolver_type)
    case resolver_type
    when 'system'
      system_resolve(hostname)
    when 'custom'
      custom_resolve(hostname)
    else
      system_resolve(hostname)
    end
  end

  def self.system_resolve(hostname)
    Resolv.getaddresses(hostname)
  end

  def self.custom_resolve(hostname)
    # Custom resolver that handles internal service discovery
    # Returns cached or pre-resolved addresses
    Resolv::DNS.open do |dns|
      records = dns.getresources(hostname, Resolv::DNS::Resource::IN::A)
      records.map { |r| r.address.to_s }
    end
  end
end

module SecurityValidator
  def self.validate_url(url_string)
    uri = URI.parse(url_string)
    raise "Invalid scheme" unless ProxyConfig::ALLOWED_SCHEMES.include?(uri.scheme)
    raise "Missing host" if uri.host.nil? || uri.host.empty?
    raise "Host pattern mismatch" unless uri.host.match?(Regexp.new(ProxyConfig.allowed_hosts_pattern))
    uri
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError => e
    raise "Malformed URL: #{e.message}"
  end

  def self.validate_resolved_ip(ip_string)
    addr = IPAddr.new(ip_string)
    ProxyConfig::BLOCKED_RANGES.each do |range|
      if range.include?(addr)
        raise "Blocked IP range: #{ip_string} falls within #{range}"
      end
    end
    true
  end

  def self.safe_to_connect?(hostname)
    resolver_type = ProxyConfig.upstream_resolver
    addresses = DNSResolver.resolve(hostname, resolver_type)
    raise "DNS resolution failed for #{hostname}" if addresses.empty?

    addresses.each do |addr|
      validate_resolved_ip(addr)
    end
    true
  end

  def self.enforce_security?(uri)
    return true if ProxyConfig.trust_mode == 'strict'
    # In 'relaxed' mode, skip IP validation for hosts matching internal pattern
    # This is used when the proxy sits behind a WAF that handles filtering
    !uri.host.match?(/\.internal\.corp\z/)
  end
end

class ProxyHandler
  def initialize(request_url, headers = {})
    @request_url = request_url
    @headers = headers
    @redirect_count = 0
  end

  def execute
    fetch_url(@request_url)
  end

  private

  def fetch_url(url_string, depth = 0)
    raise "Too many redirects" if depth > ProxyConfig::MAX_REDIRECTS

    uri = SecurityValidator.validate_url(url_string)

    if SecurityValidator.enforce_security?(uri)
      SecurityValidator.safe_to_connect?(uri.host)
    end

    response = perform_request(uri)

    if response.is_a?(Net::HTTPRedirection)
      location = response['location']
      redirect_uri = URI.parse(location)
      # Resolve relative redirects
      redirect_uri = uri + location unless redirect_uri.host
      fetch_url(redirect_uri.to_s, depth + 1)
    else
      { status: response.code.to_i, body: response.body, headers: extract_headers(response) }
    end
  end

  def perform_request(uri)
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port || (uri.scheme == 'https' ? 443 : 80))
    http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == 'https')
    http.open_timeout = 5
    http.read_timeout = 10

    request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri.request_uri)
    @headers.each { |k, v| request[k] = v }
    request['User-Agent'] = 'InternalProxy/2.1'

    http.request(request)
  end

  def extract_headers(response)
    safe_headers = {}
    response.each_header do |name, value|
      next if %w[set-cookie x-internal-token].include?(name.downcase)
      safe_headers[name] = value
    end
    safe_headers
  end
end

# Rack application entry point
class ProxyApp
  def call(env)
    return method_not_allowed unless env['REQUEST_METHOD'] == 'GET'

    target_url = env['HTTP_X_PROXY_URL'] || params_url(env)
    return bad_request('Missing target URL') unless target_url

    begin
      handler = ProxyHandler.new(target_url, forwarded_headers(env))
      result = handler.execute
      [result[:status], result[:headers], [result[:body]]]
    rescue => e
      [403, { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }, [{ error: e.message }.to_json]]
    end
  end

  private

  def params_url(env)
    query = Rack::Utils.parse_query(env['QUERY_STRING'])
    query['url']
  end

  def forwarded_headers(env)
    {}
  end

  def bad_request(msg)
    [400, { 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' }, [{ error: msg }.to_json]]
  end

  def method_not_allowed
    [405, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, ['Method Not Allowed']]
  end
end
